title: The Add Agent wizard
lede: Four wizard steps turn a person's decision into a working agent key with scopes, grants, limits and guardrails.

steps.title: Name the agent and its custodian
steps.what: Step 1 sets the agent name (permanent), the custodian it acts as, the expiry and the scopes.
steps.why: Renaming means delete and recreate; an expired key is edit-locked until the expiry moves.

steps.title: Pick what it reaches
steps.what: Step 2 sets, for llm, one provider with allowed models, rate and budget; for mcp or a2a, the apps (and optional tools). Selecting them is the grant.
steps.why: The grant policy for the custodian is created on save. The real provider key is stored, not returned.

steps.title: Set runtime protection
steps.what: Step 3 configures AI Guard for this key.
steps.why: AI Guard is per agent key, not per app, so two callers can be treated differently.

steps.title: Create and hand over the key
steps.what: Step 4 shows the key once with calling code per scope. The agent then sends it as a bearer token.
steps.why: The key is shown once: lose it and a new key is created. Brand-new keys are picked up immediately.
